component.name: symcrypt
component.summary: Encrypt and decrypt files with a password or keyfile

description.p: symcrypt is a simple, safe symmetric file-encryption tool. It encrypts files with authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305) using a key derived from a password and/or keyfile. Encrypted files begin with a self-describing, authenticated header, so they can be decrypted with only the secret — no out-of-band parameters.

This desktop application offers Encrypt, Decrypt, Info, and Verify modes with file pickers, drag-and-drop, a live progress gauge, and an Advanced section for cipher, KDF, and key-derivation cost settings.
